title: v4.1 OpenClaw environment discovery
script: $root='C:/3EN-Agent/openclaw-bridge'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $root | Out-Null; $report=[ordered]@{}; $report.openclawPresent=[bool](Get-Command openclaw -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $report.nodePresent=[bool](Get-Command node -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); $report.ollamaPresent=[bool](Get-Command ollama -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue); try{$report.ollamaTags=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:11434/api/tags' -TimeoutSec 5).models.name}catch{$report.ollamaTags=@()}; $report | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 10 | Set-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $root 'discovery.json') -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output 'V41_047_DISCOVERY=PASS'
